response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, CAST(SUM(t.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) AS fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Transaction amounts are summed as stored (unsigned), treating every transaction (PRIJEM, VYDAJ and VYBER) as a positive magnitude rather than netting credits against withdrawals.
The 'region' of the branch district is district.A3, joined via account.district_id.
The fraction's denominator is the total of amount across all transactions in trans (every account that has transactions), which equals the sum over the listed accounts.
The fraction is returned as an unrounded real number, with ties broken arbitrarily.

alternatives.interpretation: Use signed amounts: PRIJEM (credit) as positive and VYDAJ (withdrawal) as negative, so totals are net flow. VYBER has no documented direction and is treated as a withdrawal (negative). Fraction is of the net total across all accounts.
alternatives.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT s.account_id, d.A3 AS region, s.total_amount, s.transaction_count, CAST(s.total_amount AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM s) AS fraction FROM s JOIN account a ON a.account_id = s.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
